evidence.quoted_text:
if inventory[unit]["service_type"] == "simple":
            self.refuse("simple service completion has no declared execution "
                        "bound; preflight refuses this topology")
        service_timeout = inventory[unit]["service_timeout_seconds"]
evidence.reason: The completion preflight only refuses `service_type == "simple"`; it never rejects a bounded `Type=oneshot` service with `RemainAfterExit=yes`. Such a service stays active after the explicit start, so the restored timer cannot produce a second distinct invocation and the required second completion never arrives. This is an implementation defect in the existing two-completion design, not a new protection requirement.
